description: This file contains mock implementations of functions to retrieve device information such as MAC address, partner ID, model number, manufacturer name, build type, firmware version, and a function to check if a specific instance is running based on a lock file. It also includes includes and licensing comments, and uses external logging and file handling functions.

methods.name: size_t stripinvalidchar(char * pIn,size_t szIn)
methods.description: Truncates a string at the first occurrence of a space or control character, replacing subsequent characters with null terminator.

methods.name: size_t GetEstbMac(char * pEstbMac,size_t szBufSize)
methods.description: Reads the device's MAC address from a file, strips invalid characters, and stores it in a buffer.

methods.name: size_t GetPartnerId(char * pPartnerId,size_t szBufSize)
methods.description: Retrieves the device's partner ID from configuration files or defaults to 'comcast', stripping invalid characters.

methods.name: size_t GetModelNum(char * pModelNum,size_t szBufSize)
methods.description: Extracts the model number from device properties file and strips invalid characters.

methods.name: size_t GetMFRName(char * pMFRName,size_t szBufSize)
methods.description: Reads the manufacturer name from a temporary file.

methods.name: size_t GetBuildType(char * pBuildType,size_t szBufSize,BUILDTYPE * peBuildTypeOut)
methods.description: Determines the build type of the device by reading properties and firmware info, sets an enum accordingly.

methods.name: size_t GetFirmwareVersion(char * pFWVersion,size_t szBufSize)
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware version from a version file.

methods.name: bool CurrentRunningInst(const char * file)
methods.description: Checks if a lock file can be acquired to determine if an instance is already running.
